safari8998.wrapperBody:
! JO9 MOD START J9M2880 | 2026-10-10_restore_private_room_ui | changed block; context may be included
if snk_room_target > 0 and $curloc = 'stock_to_slave': gs 'snk_room_bridge', 'guard', 'stock_to_slave'
! JO9 MOD END J9M2880
!move stock slave to master and change location after

! JO9 MOD START STOCK_TO_SLAVE_CHECK_SUCCESS_20261028
if func('stock_to_slave_nogt') ! 1: exit
! JO9 MOD END STOCK_TO_SLAVE_CHECK_SUCCESS_20261028

if hunting_prize = 0 and farid_potential_debt <= 0: gt 'hard_return'
! hard_return handles get_initial_slave for starting with an assistant on easy game difficulty, and either way ends with gt $return_lock
preserve: Call existing func(stock_to_slave_nogt) exactly once; it provides the same source guard, acquisition reset, swap, trait initialization, new-slave mood, optional testing and return contract.
On return1, append the approved +0.5 entry before retaining the original condition: hunting_prize=0 and farid_potential_debt<=0 -> gt hard_return.
If that condition is false, fall through to original8998 continuation; do not unconditionally return to a different screen.
hard_return also sets sbros and may run initial-slave/new-estate/assistant setup; retain the call instead of replacing it with gt $return_lock.
The existing private-room guard in stock_to_slave only applies when curloc is that location. Keep the acquisition local to8998; do not change the shared wrappers.
safari8998.successOnlyConsumption: Using existing safari.slave=-1 and empty slave slot is enough to guard the pending trophy. Consume to1 and award only after successful conversion; generate_stock has no safari.slave reference in this baseline.
safari8998.failureNote: The old wrapper exits its own GS on result0; original8998 can then continue. A local stop/reopen on failed conversion is a separate failure-path repair, not byte-identical old flow.

pig6007.scoreBoundary: Actual delayed slave/pig swap inside special_action1, never initial61131 conversion or generic interaction_result.
pig6007.staleOriginRisk: barn does not clear hunting_prize; normal barn6007 links set interaction only. The approved origin-consumption statement is necessary to prevent unrelated later pig assignments scoring.
pig6007.delayedExecution: interaction_screen executes special_action[txt] each render without clearing it. Rewriting action1 after commit, not deleting its array element, prevents repeated score and preserves action2 indexing.
pig6007.resistance: 6007 can GT through slave_fights_back before interaction_screen. Built-but-never-executed action must not score.
pig6007.legacySaveBoundary: Old saved callback strings are not migrated and do not retroactively gain ledger code.

matches.text: gs 'stock_to_slave_nogt' &! this option is only available if there is no current slave, so we can safely do this
interaction = 6007 &! try to put slave into barn as a pig (can be resisted)
gs 'stock_to_slave_nogt' &! this option is only available if there is no current slave, so we can safely do this

cautions: No indexed killvar on special_action: removing an element can shift action2.
The only intentional origin-state change in the proposal is61131 ->0; retain hunting_prize and all unrelated city IDs.
All proposals are templates; parent owns final syntax and native behavior checks.
